description: Drift signals and thresholds for the Fernwick triage pipeline. Data, not code. Every value is integer basis points. A signal fires when its measured value reaches or exceeds its threshold. docs/domain-brief.md section 8 gives each formula; docs/decisions.md D-17..D-19 explain the choices. The thresholds were set by hand and checked against the scripted model on the frozen fixtures; they are O-5 until a real recorded batch is in.
baseline: the most recent accepted baseline window (at kickoff: batch 1 in full)

signals.what: total variation distance between the window's final category mix and the baseline's
override rate on human-touched items (queue plus audit sample) minus the baseline's
share of items that went to tier B minus the baseline's
share of items that ended in the human queue minus the baseline's
share of tier-A results with min confidence below the escalation threshold minus the baseline's
share of items the final tier reported in an unsupported language minus the baseline's
share of model results that errored, expired or failed schema validation, in the window alone
